attr.alt: The treatment area at Mason Park Dental of Katy

nodes.v: Insurance-friendly, with a plan for everyone else.
We are an insurance-friendly office with financing options, and our team will help verify what your plan covers before you commit to treatment.
Buy now, pay monthly. Let your money go further and take better control of your finances when you pay in instalments with Cherry financing.
A dental savings plan is also available for patients without insurance. Ask the front desk when you book.
One practice for the whole family.
For your convenience we provide a wide range of dental solutions in our local Katy location, for patients of all ages.
Our technology includes cone beam imaging, digital x-rays, an intra-oral camera and a soft tissue laser. Flexible scheduling and same-day emergency care are available.
$189 for the visit that tells you everything.
Exam, x-rays, cleaning and a full written treatment plan — a saving of $328. We welcome new patients of all ages.
